g.text: More GPU-resident experts: speed versus shared-memory headroom
GLM-5.3-Flash native int4 · Thor · 32 GB RAM expert cache · CUDA uses COLI_CUDA_TC_GEMM=0
Original: one start per profile. Follow-up: one CPU start; CUDA speed/latency are medians across three fresh starts.
Throughput includes prefill/HTTP overhead. Latency is the first nonempty streamed-output proxy, not exact token timing.
Memory is lowest global available RAM, not an allocation or median. Default CUDA is invalid and excluded; no historical-pair speedup claim.
